faq.chooseASubscriptionAt4999EveryMonthOr: Choose a subscription at €49.99 every month or €104.99 every three months, or buy permanently: LIFETIME is €999.99 and LIFETIME + 2 APEX is €1199.99. Lifetime plans have no recurring renewal. All plans require Apex ownership.
faq.howDoIAssignTheTwoApexRanks: How do I assign the two Apex ranks?
faq.openTheAccountPageOnTheAccountThatPurcha: Open the account page on the account that purchased LIFETIME + 2 APEX. Enter a different Minecraft username for each rank and confirm. Recipients must have joined 6b6t. Each assignment is permanent and cannot be transferred.
faq.whatIfIAlreadySubscribeToLegend: What if I already subscribe to Legend?
faq.yourExistingSubscriptionStaysUnchangedAf: Your existing subscription stays unchanged. After buying lifetime, cancel the old subscription in your account billing portal to stop future charges. Cancelling that subscription does not remove permanent Legend.
faq.whatAreTheHomeAndTeleportLimits: What are the home and teleport limits?
faq.legendIncludes500HomesTheHomeAndTpaCoold: Legend includes 500 homes. The /home and /tpa cooldowns are 10 seconds, with a 3-second teleport execution time.
faq.legendIncludesNameAndChatColorsBalloonsP: Legend includes name and chat colors, balloons, particles, glow, /hat, /skin, /sit and /cigar, plus profile customization on the website. See the feature comparison for individual limits.
faq.createAHotspotCustomizeItsNameAndGivePla: Create a Hotspot, customize its name, and give players a glow effect and a balloon.
